import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(200000)

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        u = int(data[idx])
        v = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)
    
    parent = [0] * (n + 1)
    depth = [0] * (n + 1)
    order = []
    stack = [1]
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    visited[1] = True
    
    while stack:
        u = stack.pop()
        order.append(u)
        for v in adj[u]:
            if not visited[v]:
                visited[v] = True
                parent[v] = u
                depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                stack.append(v)
    
    sz = [1] * (n + 1)
    for u in reversed(order):
        p = parent[u]
        if p != 0:
            sz[p] += sz[u]
    
    total_length = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        s = sz[i]
        rem = n - s
        total_length += min(s, rem)
    
    match = [0] * (n + 1)
    used = [False] * (n + 1)
    
    q = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if not used[i]:
                q.append(i)
    
    while q:
        u = q.pop(0)
        candidates = []
        for v in adj[u]:
            if not used[v]:
                candidates.append(v)
        
        if not candidates:
            for v in adj[u]:
                if match[v] != 0:
                    candidates.append(match[v])
        
        if not candidates:
            continue
            
        best_v = -1
        best_dist = float('inf')
        
        for v in candidates:
            dist = abs(depth[u] - depth[v])
            if dist < best_dist:
                best_dist = dist
                best_v = v
        
        if best_v != -1:
            match[u] = best_v
            used[best_v] = True
            if match[best_v] != 0:
                temp = match[best_v]
                match[best_v] = u
                used[temp] = False
                if temp != u:
                    q.append(temp)
    
    if 0 in match[1:]:
        unmatched = [i for i in range(1, n + 1) if match[i] == 0]
        unused = [i for i in range(1, n + 1) not in match[1:]]
        if len(unmatched) > 0:
            for i, u in enumerate(unmatched):
                v = unused[i % len(unused)]
                match[u] = v
    
    assignment = match[1:]
    
    print(total_length)
    print(" ".join(map(str, assignment)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
